text: Can you stay humble if your friends are proud? Only if you can handle tar and stay clean!
And watch out if your friends are rich and powerful. You cannot match their strength, and you might be crushed, just like a clay jar struck by an iron pan.
The rich oppress and insult the poor, then demand an apology!
The rich will try to use you, but if you need help, don't bother to ask.
When they come to visit you, they will soak up what little you have.
If they need your help, they smile and act kind and even ask how they can be of service. But don't be fooled— it's all lies!
They will invite you to dinner, but in the long run you'll pay three times what it cost. And when you have nothing left, they will laugh and sneer and keep their distance.
So be smart and careful, not deceived and humiliated.
Important people will want you around, if you don't try too hard to be their friend.
Push yourself on them, and you will face rejection; act cold, and they will forget that you are alive.
Don't try to be their equal or trust them when they have long talks with you. They are smiling, but you are being tested.
Those who tell secrets are cruel and would just as soon hurt you or send you to prison.
Be careful! Don't risk disaster by sharing your secrets.
Wake up and pay attention! Every day of your life, love the Lord and pray that he will protect you.[27] *
Animals and people
love their own kind.
Wolves and lambs have about as much in common as sinners and God's people.
Hyenas and dogs are natural enemies, just like the poor and the rich.
Desert lions will always feast on wild donkeys, and the rich will gobble up the needy.
The rich and proud consider the poor and humble to be disgusting.
When the rich start to stumble their friends lend a hand, but let the poor fall down, and their friends pretend not to know them.
When the rich are in trouble, many will offer to help and will even make excuses when the rich insult them. But let the poor get in trouble, and all they get is criticism, even if they speak wisely.
When the rich speak, everyone listens with great respect. But if the poor speak, everyone asks, “Just who do they think they are?” And if the poor start to trip, people give them a push.
It's good to have wealth if you got it honestly, but don't be ungodly and claim that being poor is evil.
With one look at your face anyone can see if you are happy or sad.
A smile shows you are happy, and a tired look may mean you have been trying too hard to think up a proverb.
